title: NullPointerException in KafkaProducer when send() called after metadata update failure
description: Producer metadata update failure leaves Cluster instance in partially initialized state. Subsequent record append attempts call cluster.partition() on null partition state, throwing NullPointerException in RecordAccumulator.append().
fix_patch_summary: Guard cluster.partition() call with null-safe check and propagate RetriableException to trigger metadata refresh instead of raw NPE crash.

title: Database connection pool exhaustion and socket timeout under concurrent read repair
description: Native transport connection worker pool saturates when background read repair tasks stall on unresponsive nodes. New client CQL connections time out with NoHostAvailableException / ConnectionTimeoutException after reaching max connection pool ceiling.
fix_patch_summary: Introduced dedicated bounded execution queue for read-repair messaging with drop-on-saturation policy, isolating client CQL connection listener pool.

title: SocketTimeoutException not handled during chunked HTTP/1.1 response streaming
description: When reading long chunked streams from reverse proxies, socket read timeouts cause ChunkedInputStream to leave connection socket in DIRTY state instead of releasing lease back to PoolingHttpClientConnectionManager.
fix_patch_summary: Wrapped stream consumption in try-finally block to ensure close() closes underlying socket and signals connection pool on SocketTimeoutException.

title: OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space during FST index terms dictionary construction with long terms
description: Compiling finite state transducers for terms dictionaries exceeding 10M unique tokens triggers heavy 32-bit array allocations in PositiveIntOutputs, crashing JVM with OutOfMemoryError.
fix_patch_summary: Replaced unbounded heap byte arrays with off-heap page slicing via DirectByteArrayBuffer during FST compilation phase.

title: JWT Bearer authentication filter rejects valid authorization header on header case variation
description: OAuth2 Bearer token authenticator checks Authorization header using case-sensitive lookup. Client proxies sending 'authorization' (lowercase) trigger 401 Unauthorized / TokenMissingException.
fix_patch_summary: Use case-insensitive header lookup request.getHeader('authorization') and normalize bearer token extraction prefix.
